facts.text: Kid, sit down. The grubs are crunchy, the shade is free and nobody here has to worry about a thing.
facts.why: Timon never says this. His real line when he feeds Simba is 'Listen, kid, if you live with us, you have to eat like us.'
facts.fix: Listen, kid, if you live with us, you have to eat like us.

fix_note.text: Listen, kid, if you live with us, you have to eat like us.

facts.text: Nala and the lionesses bring home dinner
facts.why: The film has the lionesses hunting under Sarabi, but when Scar is king Sarabi says there is no food and the herds have moved on, so no scene shows them bringing dinner home.
facts.fix: Nala and the lionesses out hunting for the pride

vibe.verdict: Southern African dishes suit the Pride Lands and the grub mousse hits the best food moment, but the kiosk frame and weather strip are generic.
